title: ITIL 4 Foundation – Axelos
overview: The ITIL 4 Foundation course provides a comprehensive introduction to ITIL 4, the latest version of the ITIL framework for IT service management. It covers the key concepts and components of ITIL 4, including the Service Value System (SVS) and the four dimensions of service management. The course is designed to help participants understand how ITIL principles can be applied to improve IT service management and drive business value.
audience: Individuals involved in IT service management and support.
Business leaders and decision-makers interested in IT service management best practices.
Students and learners aiming for ITIL certification and knowledge in service management.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of ITIL 4 concepts and components.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to apply ITIL principles and best practices.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore ITIL concepts and their application.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
Interactive Activities: Exercises and role-playing to reinforce learning and application.
competencies: Service Value System (SVS) and Service Value Chain
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a foundational understanding of ITIL 4 and its key concepts.
To familiarize participants with the ITIL Service Value System (SVS) and Service Value Chain.
To prepare participants for the ITIL 4 Foundation certification exam.
To equip participants with knowledge to apply ITIL practices to improve IT service management.
